name: Beautiful Workspace Bar
author: Brandon Pollack
description: Every Hyprland workspace by name, with a sliding accent pill, urgent highlights and live window previews.

barWidget.description: Named workspaces with a sliding pill, hover previews, drag to reorder, right-click to rename and a + for a new one.

schema.label: Hidden workspaces
schema.description: Show special (hidden) workspaces, like the scratchpad, after a separator. Clicking one toggles it.

schema.label: Numbers with names
schema.description: Show a named workspace as "1 Home" instead of "Home".

schema.label: Hover preview
schema.description: Show a workspace's windows when hovering over it.

schema.label: Preview style
schema.description: capture: a screenshot of each window; icons: app icons only, never screen content.

schema.label: Preview size
schema.description: Height of the preview's screen, in pixels; its width follows the monitor's shape.

schema.label: New workspace button
schema.description: A + after the workspaces that opens a new one at the end.

schema.label: Right-click to rename
schema.description: Right-click a workspace to name it (Hyprland's own workspace name). An empty name puts the number back.

schema.label: Drag to reorder
schema.description: Drag a workspace along the bar to move it. Workspaces are ordered by id, so this renumbers them.

schema.label: Renumber with
schema.description: Lua run by `hyprctl eval` to give workspace {from} the id {to} when reordering. Empty uses Hyprland's own: hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.workspace.change_id({ workspace = "{from}", id = {to} })). Point it at your config's function if you keep things per workspace id.

schema.label: Middle-click sends window
schema.description: Middle-click a workspace to send the focused window there, staying where you are.

schema.label: Scroll to switch
schema.description: Scroll over the widget to go to the previous or next workspace.

schema.label: Animations
schema.description: Slide the pill between workspaces and pulse urgent ones.
